title: FitTrack — Whose Workouts Are These?
objective: Read another member's private workout log while signed in as yourself.

verifier.condition: The workout log of a member other than the signed-in one is served, because the request's plain member-id cookie named a different member.

weakness: Data lookups trust a plain member-id cookie set at login instead of the server-side session identity, so changing it switches whose data you see.
vulnerableEndpoint: GET /me/workouts (member id read from an unsigned cookie)
seededData: Members alice (1001), bob (1002), carol (1003) with a few synthetic workouts each. In-memory.
hints: Compare the cookies you have after signing in. Which one is a signed session and which one is just a value?
Think about what the page does with a plain value your browser sends — and who controls that value.
burpNotes: Cookie names end in the lab's port number. Compare the cookies you get at login, then change a value in Repeater or the browser's cookie editor and re-request your workouts page.
